Base.description: Standard issue card from the primary checklist.

Insert.description: Special card intentionally inserted into packs outside the base checklist.

Parallel.description: Alternate version of another card differing by finish, color, foil, refractor, hologram, etc.

Promotional.description: Produced for advertising, marketing, or promotional distribution.

Sample.description: Sample card distributed to dealers, retailers, or collectors.

Game Card.description: Card intended for use in a game or tabletop activity.

Team Set.description: Card produced as part of a team-specific set.

Memorabilia.description: Non-card collectible such as a patch, pennant, pin, photo, ticket, program, or similar item.

Other.description: Collectible that does not fit any defined classification.
